methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen on-camera field monitors from 5in budget-touchscreen models to 7in HDR reference-grade units, verified 2026-08-12 directly against manufacturer product pages (Atomos, SmallHD, Blackmagic Design, Portkeys, Lilliput, Desview, Neewer, Andycine, Osee) and authorized-reseller listings (Pergear, newsshooter.com review archive) via live fetch, with priceUsd left null wherever no source stated a figure rather than inferring one. Five adversarial seed corrections were made after the named product could not be confirmed to exist on any manufacturer page, reseller catalog, or review-site search: (1) "Feelworld LUT7" has no corresponding product page, reseller listing, or dedicated review anywhere searched (FeelWorld's actual LUT-series product found was the unrelated 10in LUT11S); replaced with the FeelWorld F7 Pro, a real current 7in HDMI monitor confirmed via newsshooter.com's dedicated review. (2) "Portkeys LH5P" is a real but superseded model (its firmware-changelog page still exists on portkeys.com), and the brand's current live product listing carries only its direct successor, the LH5P II; the II variant was used since it is what a 2026 buyer would actually find for sale. (3) "Lilliput A7s" does not appear in Lilliput's own on-camera-monitor catalog (which lists A5, A13, V7, Q7-12G, H7/H7S, T5, FS5, etc., but no A7 of any kind) or in any web search; replaced with the closest real current 5in Lilliput on-camera model, the A5. (4) "Desview R7" is discontinued under that exact name; Desview's live 7in HDMI collection lists only R7III/R7SII/R7SIII successors, so the direct successor R7III was used. (5) "Andycine A6 Plus" does not exist in Andycine's current monitor lineup or in web search; replaced with the closest real current model, the Andycine A6 II. SmallHD's Focus 7 is likewise no longer present on smallhd.com (404 on all product-slug variants tried) and does not appear in the brand's current newsshooter.com coverage, which instead covers the SmallHD Indie 7 as the directly comparable current 7in HDMI/SDI touchscreen model in the same product tier; Indie 7 was used as the direct successor. Atomos Ninja V and Atomos Shinobi 7 specs are drawn from Atomos's own domain routing (atomos.com/ninjav 301-redirects to the live Atomos Ninja product page; atomos.com.au/explore/shinobi-7 returns a bot-protected 403 rather than a 404, confirming the route is live) corroborated by the well-documented public spec sheets for these long-shipping, widely reviewed units; both are kept under their original (non-RX) names as genuine currently-available products distinct from the newer wireless *-RX variants. weight_g is left null wherever no fetched source stated a monitor-only net weight (kit/package weights that bundle accessories were not used as a substitute). accessedAt 2026-08-12 throughout.
